json-canvas._comment: Vendored rather than installed via the marketplace, for the same reason Genjutsu and claudedesignskills were: `npx skills add` and `/plugin install` are user-level by nature and cannot be confined to one project. Only 2 of the 5 upstream skills were taken - obsidian-bases and obsidian-cli have no use here (Obsidian CLI is not installed on this machine and nothing consumes .base files), and defuddle is a web-scraping skill this bot has no need for. Same 'only what is used' rule as the 2-of-27 claudedesignskills install. Reviewed before enabling: both skills are pure format documentation, no shell, no network, no credential access.
